verdict.rationale: Orama documents its own bulk insert, `insertMultiple`, recommended for large record sets and offering a configurable batch size (default 1000), so bulk insertion across many items is directly supported. The pack shows no equivalent bulk update or bulk delete, and no bulk operations exposed through the Cloud API or MCP server for AI-native use. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete operations, bulk operations via Cloud API/MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Inserting a large number of documents in a loop could potentially block the event loop. Instead `insertMultiple` handles this case better.
You can pass a third, optional, parameter to change the batch size (default: 1000).
If you have a lot of records, we suggest using the `insertMultiple` function
